title: Safe Management Measures for Full-Time National Servicemen and COVID-19 Cases in Camps
what_it_is: Safe Management Measures for Full-Time National Servicemen and COVID-19 Cases in Camps

sections.label: SAF COVID-19 protection measures
sections.summary: The SAF uses vaccination, testing, safe management measures and rapid containment to protect personnel, including NSFs, from COVID-19 and prevent large outbreaks.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: The Singapore Armed Forces (SAF) has measures to protect its personnel, including Full-Time National Servicemen (NSFs) against COVID-19 and to prevent large outbreaks.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: These include vaccination, testing and safe management measures (SMMs), as well as rapid containment in the event of cases.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: More than 99.7% of SAF personnel have received two vaccination shots and close to 87% have received booster shots.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: To detect COVID-19 infections early and to minimise its spread, the SAF has also instituted regular testing and SMMs, such as smaller group sizes and mask-on policy where possible.

sections.label: Rising SAF infection numbers
sections.summary: Weekly infection numbers rose about 17% amid the Omicron surge, mostly from the community, with limited onward transmission and mild or no symptoms.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Even with these measures, our weekly infection numbers have increased by about 17% from the previous week, along with the surge in community cases due to the Omicron variant.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Most of these cases were brought in from the community and detected through our routine tests.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: While there has been limited onward transmission within our camps and bases, and the vast majority of SAF personnel who contracted the virus have exhibited either mild or no symptoms so far, we are not taking things for granted.
